ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Solve: The graphs of the linear functions $y_1=4x+5$ and $y_2=3x+10$ intersect at point P(5, 25).\\
Therefore, the solution set for $4x+5>3x+10$ is: $\boxed{x>5}$.
